title: Triangle Congruence
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating triangle congruence postulates including SSS (Side-Side-Side) and SAS (Side-Angle-Side).
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Triangles
Congruence
learningObjectives: Explain the SSS postulate: triangles with three pairs of equal corresponding sides are congruent
Explain the SAS postulate: triangles with two equal sides and an equal included angle are congruent
Predict whether two triangles remain congruent as the sliders change side lengths and the included angle
Distinguish which measurements, sides versus the included angle, each congruence postulate requires
